description: Brex helps finance teams and employees review company spend through ChatGPT. Users can look up expenses, cards, limits, users, bills, vendors, and accounting records; analyze spend; attach receipts from HTTPS URLs; update memos and attendees; assign card expenses to limits; export expense data; and submit product feedback.

defaultPrompt: How much did I spend on Delta last year?
